description: This file is a unit test class for the OAuthClientDao within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin. It contains tests for CRUD operations, data retrieval, and filtering of OAuth client entities, verifying correct behavior of OAuthClientDao methods.

classes.name: OAuthClientDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing OAuthClientDao, encompassing methods for testing creation, retrieval, listing, counting, and deletion of OAuth clients.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of OAuthClientDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveOAuthClient
methods.description: Tests saving a new OAuthClient entity and verifies its fields are saved correctly.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of OAuth client list with filtering, asserting expected number of clients and their properties.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of OAuth clients matches expected value.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an OAuth client by ID, including a case where ID does not exist.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of OAuth client by client ID, including a negative case.

methods.name: testDeleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Tests deletion of OAuth clients by ID and verifies the remaining clients.
